items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: The interviewer mentions Mona McMurray as the host/location owner, but the interviewee (Sing Miller) does not mention her or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: Okay. Today is January 17th. We are at 1433 Dolphin, the home of Mona McMurray. We have Sing Miller and Kid Sheik here. We've just been making some tapes of some of Sing's records. And now we'd like to talk a little bit about Sing's life history. When were you

born Sing? 1913, June the 17th. And where? 546 Lines Street. The house I was born is still there, painted green, in the middle of the block. You still see it? See, there was another week. Where did you go to school first? I was Lutheran School.
